ResearchProjectDef.label: artificial psychic circuitry
ResearchProjectDef.description: Reverse-engineered from the psychic circuitry that makes up the horn organ of the thrumbo, this technique lets the Colonization Fleet mass-produce psylink neuroformers with complex zero-gravity vacuum lithography. Because archotech machines are beyond control, however, the program was bound by treaty and by local production conditions, and it was never rolled out. Yet in the armed conflict with the native psycasters of Anima Prime, the locals - with the planet's abundant thrumbo herds - refined it into a production method far better suited to rimworlds.\n\nThe Colonization ████ Fleet's long-term records and studies of the thrumbo have established that the thrumbo is a ████ ████ creature, and the species' indifference to its own systematic slaughter by humans is most likely ████. Approved by ████ and ██, artificial psychic circuitry and its related technologies are designated class II sealed technology. Disclosure of such technology to developing worlds is prohibited, so that a leak does not lead to the systematic hunting and extinction of the thrumbos of colonized worlds.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterTitle: Sealed file II: artificial psychic circuitry
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText:
Using the data they have gathered, researchers have finished decoding the sealed technology. It records how the natives of Anima Prime turned thrumbo horn into psylink neuroformers.

Psylink neuroformers can now be made at a fabrication bench from a thrumbo horn and advanced components.

The fleets sealed this file so that no colonized world would learn what a thrumbo horn is worth. Every neuroformer made this way is paid for with a thrumbo.

RecipeDef.label: make psylink neuroformer
RecipeDef.description: Make a psylink neuroformer from a thrumbo horn, by the method the natives of Anima Prime refined.
